required_fixes: Fix required_to_optional intermittency: provenance.json:design_notes and spec.json describe field present ~50% of time, but research/graph/freshness_detection/execute_usage_profiling.py lines 260-267 unconditionally continue for both even and odd resource_id, making required_to_optional a deterministic removal of 'name' (100% missing) rather than 50% intermittent. Future test of truly intermittent optionality must implement conditional inclusion.

Empirically measure positive_control_fresh_copies instead of tautological 'by construction' assertion: result.json:controls.positive_control_fresh_copies passes via logic, but no fresh-vs-fresh server measurement exists in raw_evidence/experiment_data.json. Fresh-vs-fresh should be executed as an explicit condition.

Replace adversarially favorable noise model: spec.json and execute_usage_profiling.py generate_stale_optional_churn/null_valued_fields/nested_object_variation add fields guaranteed not in any CLIENT_PROFILES (A={id,name},B={id,name,email},C={id,name,email,phone}). This makes condition2_noise_tolerance trivially PASS (usage_similarity=1.0 by construction). Future work must test noise that overlaps client-requested fields.

Add client-side type validation to test change_type detectability: result.json observation that change_type usage_similarity=1.0 reflects measurement definition (execute_usage_profiling.py line 368: if f in data and data[f] is not None) which ignores type mismatch. To claim field-usage cannot detect type drift, must test type-aware client that rejects unexpected types.
Exercise stable_resource_control per spec or remove it: spec.json positive_control/null_control not fully exercised; result.json:controls.stable_resource_control reports N/A without measurement.

validity_findings.finding: Noise immunity is baked into design: all three noise generators add fields with names churn_opt_*, null_field_*, *.nested_* that no CLIENT_PROFILE requests. Therefore per_pattern_noise_usage_similarity mean=1.0 std=0.0 for all 12 noise conditions (derived_measurements.json per_schema_size 10/20/30/50 noise_all 1.0) is a construction artefact, not empirical robustness. Real-world noise affecting used fields would close discrimination_gap.

change_type is invisible by measurement definition, not by inherent behavioral signal. Server returns integer vs string for id (execute_usage_profiling.py 269-272), but client counts field as used if present and non-null (line 368). Type mismatch not validated. Thus per_pattern_drift_usage_similarity change_type mean=1.0 is measurement-valid negative for availability-only definition but does not falsify type-aware usage profiling.

validity_findings.finding: required_to_optional intended as 50% intermittent presence (provenance.json:design_notes, spec preregmd, validity_notes). Code has dead branch: both even and odd paths execute continue (lines 262-267), so field is always absent. Observed per_pattern_drift_usage_similarity required_to_optional mean=0.638889 exactly equals deterministic removal of 'name' (A 0.5,B 0.666667,C 0.75) and shows zero variance, not 50% intermittency.

positive_control_fresh_copies not executed as server condition; passes by identity (identical schemas by construction). No fresh-vs-fresh measurement in raw_evidence/experiment_data.json. Claim usage_similarity=1.0 Jaccard=1.0 is logically true for set equality but not an empirical discrimination check.

validity_findings.finding: Mock server deterministic, zero timing jitter, no stochastic field availability, no DB/cache/CDN variation (provenance.json:execution_environment stdlib only). Validity_notes correctly disclose real-world usage-similarity may be noisier. discrimination_gap 0.165 and pearson_r -0.045 are ceiling values under idealization.

Three hand-designed profiles covering email/phone dependency create asymmetric sensitivity: Profile A unaffected by remove_field when email removed (mean per_profile_usage_similarity_remove_field A 1.0 vs C 0.75). Bimodal raw usage_similarities for remove_field (0.805556 and 0.916667) correspond to email vs phone removal. Generalization to arbitrary real client field subsets untested; validity_notes disclose limit.

validity_findings.finding: Jaccard and usage_similarity are different Jaccards on different objects (structural (field_path,type) vs per-profile field_used sets) with different baselines; Pearson r computed across 24 aggregated condition means (derived_measurements.json overall all_jaccard_values vs all_usage_sim_values) not per-sample. Zero-variance noise conditions anchor correlation near zero. Low r confirms orthogonality within this aggregated design but per-sample correlation untested.

baseline_findings.baseline: Single-signal Jaccard (field_path,type) with adaptive threshold — FP=1.0 at all sizes under structural noise (EXP-GRAPH-34788722106)
baseline_findings.assessment: Comparative baseline correctly cited. Current experiment reproduces Jaccard structural values (derived_measurements.json per_schema_size_jaccard via result.json metrics: 0.90-0.98 drift, 0.909 noise) showing same magnitude-confined variation. Usage-similarity provides complementary signal where Jaccard alone conflates drift and noise, but does not rescue type drift.

baseline_findings.baseline: TF-IDF bag-of-words semantic similarity — FP=1.0, inverted direction (EXP-GRAPH-35010853847)
baseline_findings.assessment: Baseline correctly inherited as falsified semantic signal; not directly comparable to field-usage but shares inverted magnitude confound theme. No new TF-IDF measurement in this experiment; citation is appropriate.

baseline_findings.baseline: Response-time KS two-sample test — TP=0.0, FP=0.1875, inverted direction (EXP-GRAPH-35083040517)
baseline_findings.assessment: Temporal baseline correctly cited as falsified; current deterministic server removes timing confound entirely, isolating behavioral availability. Orthogonality claim (Pearson r -0.045) specifically demonstrates usage-similarity not confounded with structural magnitude in same way as KS.

baseline_findings.baseline: Linear Fisher LDA ensemble of (1-Jaccard) and KS D — AUC=0.625, all conditions fail (EXP-GRAPH-35130682058)
baseline_findings.assessment: Parent experiment handoff correctly carried forward; current experiment tests fundamentally different signal family (functional access vs structural/temporal) as parent recommended. Partial success (2/3 drift patterns) advances beyond LDA failure but does not achieve full ensemble viability. No nonlinear ensemble tested on new features per parent unknown.

baseline_findings.baseline: null_control: Structural noise patterns must NOT reduce usage-similarity below 0.95
baseline_findings.assessment: Null control passes empirically (noise_usage_mean 1.0 >=0.95, all per_pattern_noise_usage_similarity all_sizes_above_0.95 true) but is weak due to V_NOISE_TAUTOLOGICAL. Control does not stress the signal; it verifies construction.

claim_ceiling: FROZEN HYPOTHESIS FALSIFIED-IN-SETTING: Field-usage profiling as defined (mean per-profile Jaccard(field_used_fresh, field_used_stale) with presence-only counting) does NOT satisfy the frozen decision rule for C-FRESHNESS across all three drift patterns; Condition1 fails on change_type at all 4 sizes. Maximum justified ceiling is narrower: Within deterministic mock server (Python stdlib http.server, seed 20260916, sizes 10/20/30/50, N=30 per condition, 3 hand-designed profiles A/B/C) field-usage availability provides orthogonal discrimination for field-availability drift (remove_field mean 0.865 <0.90 and required_to_optional mean 0.639 <0.90) while remaining immune to synthetic structural noise that adds only unused fields (noise mean 1.0 >=0.95), with near-zero aggregated Pearson correlation r=-0.045 confirming information beyond structural Jaccard. This partial signal does NOT extend to: type-compatibility drift without client type validation, noise that affects fields clients use, intermittent optionality at 50% presence (untested due to dead code making required_to_optional deterministic), per-sample correlation, real APIs with stochastic availability, optimal profile design, or broader C-FRESHNESS. Composite Jaccard+usage ensemble for full drift coverage remains hypothetical.
unresolved: Whether type-aware client validation (rejecting fields with unexpected types) would make change_type detectable and close Condition1 gap — requires modeling type schemas and client parsing.
Whether usage-similarity discrimination survives when noise patterns affect fields actually used by clients (not just unused churn/null/nested fields).
Whether truly intermittent required_to_optional (field present 50% of responses) yields different usage_similarity than deterministic removal currently measured (0.638889).
Whether real APIs with DB/cache/CDN, stochastic availability, and heterogeneous production client profiles preserve 0.165 discrimination gap and near-zero Jaccard correlation.
Whether composite signal (Jaccard + usage_similarity + type-compatibility) could detect all three drift patterns simultaneously despite individual limitations.
Per-sample (not aggregated mean) Pearson r and per-sample ROC for Jaccard vs usage-similarity — aggregation to 24 mean pairs may mask sample-level structure.
Optimal number and diversity of client profiles for generalization beyond light/medium/heavy hand-designed sets.
